design_rules: R1 no fork on the per-key path
R2 about 15-20 kklass calls per key, none per row or cell; lists take a data array + optional plain formatter
R3 one screen buffer of row strings (chars + palette symbols), per-row damage columns, colour runs, one printf per frame; no z-order clip walk, no group buffers
R4 partial redraw for lists and editors
R5 (revised after round K) methods may hold loops; copy fields a hot loop reads into locals
